question: Can you locate a nature reserve within a 180 kilometers radius around School of Cosmetology, Somerset, KY?
sql: SELECT id, poi_name AS name, 'poi' AS type FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%School of Cosmetology%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Somerset%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ), 180000) UNION ALL SELECT id, park_name AS name, 'park' AS type FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%School of Cosmetology%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Somerset%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ), 180000);
